name: Đầu ghi hình IP Network Storage System Hikvision DS-A80624S
summary: Up to 24 HDD, each disk up to 4TB capacity and cascade extension support
Support 120 –Ch(2M) record and play in IP-SAN mode,192 –Ch(2M) record and play in CVR mode
RAID 0, 1, 3, 5, 10, 50 and HDD hot swap supported
